results.name: Server validates buyer, seller, six people, hidden answers and non-empty signatures

Buyer and seller browser journeys collect two and three people through a saved local receipt

Concurrent repeated submits create one encrypted submission, case, person set and send job
Simulated LiveSign creates/starts once and preserves account-holder billing and all people

Provider identity and AML results sync independently; confirmations are deduplicated
Uncertain create result is held for reconciliation instead of a second paid request
Anonymous/private access, unauthenticated worker/webhook and forged verification results are denied
Owner sees completed answers, signature and automatic statuses; answer correction is blocked
